name: telemetry-taco
description: Lightweight telemetry tool designed to correlate Feature Usage with System Health in real-time

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run python manage.py runserver
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run celery -A core worker --loglevel=info
scripts.migrate: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run python manage.py migrate
scripts.generate:api-types: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=telemetry_taco.settings.test poetry run python manage.py export_openapi_schema ../frontend/openapi.json && cd ../frontend && pnpm generate:api-types
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run ruff check .
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run ruff format .
scripts.format:check:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run ruff format --check .
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=telemetry_taco.settings.test poetry run python manage.py check
scripts.test: pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:sdk
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run pytest
scripts.test:sdk: cd sdk && PYTEST_PYTHON=$(POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry -C ../backend run python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)') && "$PYTEST_PYTHON" -m pytest tests
scripts.security:backend: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run bandit -r . -c bandit.yaml
scripts.security:backend:json: cd backend && POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pypoetry-cache poetry run bandit -r . -f json -o bandit-report.json -c bandit.yaml
scripts.validate:backend: pnpm lint:backend && pnpm format:check:backend && pnpm check:backend && pnpm test:backend
scripts.validate:frontend: pnpm generate:api-types && pnpm --filter ./frontend lint && pnpm --filter ./frontend type-check && pnpm --filter ./frontend test && pnpm --filter ./frontend build
scripts.validate:all: pnpm validate:backend && pnpm validate:frontend && pnpm test:sdk
